method: Read-only review of current source, its original frozen expressions, C21J admission and existing E1/E2 results. No test, native process or IVP was run by this reviewer.

checks.finding: Original left-associated multiplication tree preserved; E expression and cross order retained.
Strict Python float/np.float64 finite admission; packed binary64 preserves signed zero and adjacent values.
Miss returns its newly computed arrays; cached arrays use separate immutable bytes backing; hits return owned writable copies.
Private reference/callback import hooks cover run_experiment.opacity; default H remains original; public opacity/H mutation is checked in replay.
Pinned manifests and source hashes reused; tuple-owned fixture, same object identity, per-cell clearing, direct binding mutation checks.
C21K setup subtracts from inherited remaining one-job wall budget; positive finite wall and final deadline check retained.
Pinned C21J replay and INPUT_PINS, complete native job and RPC terminal admission reused; expected replies and derivative nodes compared.
Saved accepted states are consumed for summary reconstruction; no new forward IVP or native-process admission is claimed by replay.

findings.original_issue: Float coercion accepted unsupported numeric types while miss computation still used original x; this could merge different arithmetic semantics.
findings.correction: EPOCH_BINARY64_ARGUMENT_REQUIRED and negative float32/longdouble/int/bool test source added.
findings.dynamic_gate: Root focused execution receipt is authoritative; reviewer did not run the tests.

remaining_assumptions: Cross-section and math/NumPy internal globals and FP environment are fixed; direct function-pointer checks do not prove immunity to arbitrary runtime monkeypatches.
Pointwise numeric equivalence concerns successful finite admitted values, not warning counts, object addresses, profiling side effects or failure timing outside the admitted domain.
No current NCP resource observation, native speedup certification or global error certificate is supplied by this review.
